scope: Discovery frames for the remaining 75 inventory slots; search results are leads, not admitted cases.
ordering: created ascending; split into calendar-year queries if search exceeds GitHub's 1000-result ceiling; otherwise fail closed and preserve captures.
screening: Review threads must contain a substantive correctness claim with source IDs. Post-merge reports must have fixing evidence and a recoverable introducing opportunity before admission. Comment counts, closed status and regression wording are discovery signals only.
bias: Discussion-volume selection favors active PRs and automation-heavy repositories; regression-title selection misses reports with other wording. These targeted frames complement the separately frozen comment-independent sample and do not change its selection.
